description: Na₂PtH₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to twelve equivalent H⁰ᐧ⁶⁷⁻ atoms to form NaH₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaH₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaH₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent PtH₆ octahedra. All Na-H bond lengths are 2.57 Å. Pt²⁺ is bonded to six equivalent H⁰ᐧ⁶⁷⁻ atoms to form PtH₆ octahedra that share faces with eight equivalent NaH₁₂ cuboctahedra. All Pt-H bond lengths are 1.64 Å. H⁰ᐧ⁶⁷⁻ is bonded to four equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Pt²⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing HNa₄Pt square pyramids.
